title: fumaria indica
intro: Fumaria indica, commonly known as Indian fumitory or Indian earth smoke, is a flowering plant species in the family Fumariaceae. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as fever, cough, and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria indica are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual disorders, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
